name: Standing dumbbell hammer curl
definition: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing inward. Bend both elbows together while retaining the neutral grip, then lower.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing inward.
value.movement: Bend both elbows together while retaining the neutral grip, then lower.
value.finish: Return the dumbbells to the sides.
value.range_of_motion: Repeatable elbow travel; upper arms remain near the torso.
